⎿ ❯ Research the Context7 MCP server. I need to understand the resolve-library-id tool specifically - what arguments does it accept and which are required?

For the Context7 MCP server, the tool resolve-library-id takes exactly two arguments, and both are required:

  • query (required, string): The user’s original question/task. Context7 uses this to rank matching libraries by relevance to what you’re trying to do. GitHub+1

  • libraryName (required, string): The library/package name you want to resolve into a Context7-compatible library ID. GitHub+1

There are no optional arguments documented for resolve-library-id in the published tool schema/readme. GitHub+1

Example payload

json
{
  "query": "How do I create an async engine and session in SQLModel?",
  "libraryName": "sqlmodel"
}
